summary.headline: Outcomes of the Fixed Stars
summary.text: Editorial notes on the Angelicus and Ambrosian codices, including Daniel Serruys’s contribution, precede chapter 135 on the outcomes of the fixed stars. The astrological text explains how the Moon and bright fixed stars at the pivots, ascendant, midheaven, western, or subterranean positions affect fame, wealth, marriage, inheritance, fortune, and reputation at death.
